data.name: Improved Bull Rush (Mythic)
data.description:
You push foes around with amazing ease. You gain a bonus equal to half your tier on checks to bull rush, and to your CMD when an opponent bull rushes you. These bonuses stack with those granted by non-mythic Improved Bull Rush.
Furthermore, you can make an attack of opportunity against any creature that attempts to bull rush you, unless it also has this feat.
